name: architecture-review-adr
title: Architecture review — plan-only to enforced decisions
summary: Invoke the architecture-review workflow as a plan only, then show the load-bearing decision index, fail-on-drift check, and an ADR artifact passing structure validation.
systemOverlay: Demo mode for the architecture review path. Run the exact construct CLI commands from each step using shell or construct_tool. Procedure invoke is plan-only — it proposes the Worker Profile chain and does not author the ADR. Do not hand-author decision records or ADR markdown in chat.

steps.title: Plan only — architecture review procedure
steps.prompt: Run construct procedure invoke for architecture-review in proposal-only mode and show the Worker Profile chain. This is plan-only — it does not draft the ADR.
steps.command: node bin/construct procedure invoke --json --workflow-type architecture-review --approval-mode proposal-only --text 'Review the orchestration runtime boundary for failure modes'

steps.title: Decision index — load-bearing decisions
steps.prompt: Run construct decisions list to show indexed load-bearing decisions and their enforcement bindings.

steps.title: Drift check — fail on dangling markers
steps.prompt: Run construct decisions check to verify there are no dangling markers or enforcement/supersede/linkage drift.

steps.title: ADR artifact PASS — validate structure
steps.prompt: Run artifact validate on the golden ADR fixture to confirm it satisfies the ADR structure and citation requirements.
